$comment: Parity ledger (ADR 0092). One item per capability that can differ between surfaces, with a status on ios and android (Bipe's app, bipe-app), web (bipe-web) and server (bipe-api, bipe-infra): planned, built (merged, not in a tester build), testing (in a tester build), policy, or n/a with a reason. built and testing need evidence: paths that start with bipe-app/ios/ or bipe-app/android/ (merged code, never a spec), bipe-web/, bipe-api/ or bipe-infra/. fork: true marks an item that the archived Element X fork app ships (ADR 0155): until bipe-app replaces it in the stores, such an item is built or testing on ios and android, or planned with the open issue that builds it (issue), or n/a with a reason and the ADR that excludes it (adr), or n/a with a reason and fork: false when the fork app does not ship it on that platform. This is the one status per feature: product.json features have none, bipe-web and gen-product-doc.mjs read it by id. When iOS and Android differ, issue names the open issue that closes the gap (--issues checks that it is open). differences: deliberate behaviour differences between the apps; kind idiom, gap or undecided (gap and undecided need an issue). Check: node tools/parity.mjs. Report: --report.
